title: Fully Bayesian Spectral Clustering and Benchmarking with Uncertainty Quantification for Small Area Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2512.15643v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, inspired by machine learning techniques, we propose a new Bayesian model for Small Area Estimation (SAE), the Fay-Herriot model with Spectral Clustering (FH-SC). Unlike traditional approaches, clustering in FH-SC is based on spectral clustering algorithms that utilize external covariates, rather than geographical or administrative criteria. A major advantage of the FH-SC model is its flexibility in integrating existing SAE approaches, with or without clustering random effects. To enable benchmarking, we leverage the theoretical framework of posterior projections for constrained Bayesian inference and derive closed form expressions for the new Rao-Blackwell (RB) estimators of the posterior mean under the FH-SC model. Additionally, we introduce a novel measure of uncertainty for the benchmarked estimator, the Conditional Posterior Mean Square Error (CPMSE), which is generalizable to other Bayesian SAE estimators. translated_title: 面向小区域估计的全贝叶斯谱聚类与基准校正及不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，受机器学习技术的启发，我们提出了一种新的小区域估计贝叶斯模型——带谱聚类的Fay-Herriot模型（FH-SC）。与传统方法不同，FH-SC中的聚类基于利用外部协变量的谱聚类算法，而非地理或行政区划标准。FH-SC模型的一个主要优势在于其灵活性，能够整合现有的小区域估计方法，无论是否对随机效应进行聚类。为实现基准校正，我们利用后验投影的约束贝叶斯推断理论框架，推导出了FH-SC模型下新的后验均值Rao-Blackwell（RB）估计量的闭式表达式。此外，我们为基准校正后的估计量引入了一种新颖的不确定性度量——条件后验均方误差（CPMSE），该度量可推广至其他贝叶斯小区域估计估计量。
tldr: 提出了基于谱聚类的贝叶斯小区域估计新模型FH-SC，借助后验投影理论推导出基准校正后的Rao-Blackwell估计量闭式解，并引入可推广的条件后验均方误差（CPMSE）来量化基准估计量的不确定性。
en_tdlr: A novel spectral clustering-based Bayesian small area estimation model (FH-SC) is proposed, which enables benchmarking through posterior projections with closed-form Rao-Blackwell estimators and introduces a generalizable uncertainty measure (CPMSE) for benchmarked estimators.
